terra.problem: The master is returning from a wedding banquet, so saying nobody traveling is mentioned is inaccurate.
Waiting until dawn would not necessarily leave the master outside all night. The passage does not say when he arrives.
Lunch is a food reference in a comparison, and it is not mentioned in the passage.
The passage says the master dresses himself to serve, but it does not say he puts on an apron.
The passage says the Son of Man will come at an unexpected hour, not that nobody knows the hour. Matthew 24:36 says the Father knows it.
Jesus has said the Son of Man will come at an unexpected hour, not that nobody knows the hour. Matthew 24:36 says the Father knows it.
The explanation omits that the servant unknowingly does things worthy of punishment. As written, it suggests that simply not knowing brings the blows.
